jay: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the existing cute gouache Lidth's jay illustration to revise. Image 2 is an actual adult Garrulus lidthi photo showing a SLENDER long-tailed CORVID. Keep Image 1's charming loose thick charcoal outlines, flat cobalt and chestnut gouache, subtle crayon texture, small dot eye, black periocular mask and ivory bill. Change its silhouette to recognizable adult jay proportions based on Image 2: substantially less round belly and chest, a narrower elongated sloping torso, visibly longer and slightly slimmer neck, slightly smaller head relative to body, LONG tapering tail (about equal to torso length rather than short robin-like tail), natural moderately long legs. Friendly and simplified but NOT a squat sparrow or plump robin. Preserve black lores/eye region, chestnut mantle and lower belly, blue head throat wings and tail, modest white tail tip. Full body in a gently alert standing pose facing right, no branch, no scenery, no text, no cast shadow or glow. TRUE transparent background alpha. Keep all appendages within frame with margin.
